argument: Chapter 12 presents two contradictory formats for its two-Discipline cards. Tide of Life, Soulmend, and Briar Wall each open their Weak/Standard/Strong block at 2/4/6, the Novice row, even though a card at the Adept tier must begin at 6/9/12. In each case the card's own Adept line then restates 6/9/12, so the opening rung sits a full row under budget and the Adept rung deepens nothing. The chapter contradicts itself: Restoration and Flesh Renewal, same two-rank Life prerequisite and same tier, correctly open at 6/9/12, as does every arcane card at that tier. Broken value 2/4/6; required value 6/9/12.

evidence.claim: Tide of Life carries a two-rank Life prerequisite, an Adept gate, yet its opening block heals only 2/4/6 to each ally, and its Adept line jumps to 6/9/12.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Restore 2 HP to each ally in range

evidence.claim: Soulmend shares that two-rank Life prerequisite and likewise opens at 2/4/6 HP restored, one full row beneath what the Adept tier requires.
Briar Wall needs two Plants ranks, an Adept card again, but its opening block deals only 2/4/6 piercing; the Adept line then supplies the 6/9/12 the base should have carried.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Creatures passing through take 2 piercing damage

evidence.claim: The same prerequisite and tier appear on Restoration and Flesh Renewal, which open at 6/9/12, so the chapter disagrees with itself about the Adept opening row.
The arcane sibling prints the Adept row, 6/9/12, in the opening block of its two-Discipline cards such as Brimstone Burst, so the divine chapter's 2/4/6 openings break the shared card format.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: 6 fire damage to all in the radius

evidence.claim: The framework fixes the starting effect row by purchase tier, stating that a card taken at the Adept tier opens at 6/9/12 and that this row governs however the card is shaped.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: A card bought at Adept tier starts at 6/9/12

evidence.claim: Expected opening 6/9/12 against the printed 2/4/6 on those three Adept cards; the shortfall is one complete damage row per card.
